speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: However, the Code does not prescribe specific methods or technologies.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: The designated app stores can decide what works best for them, as long as the online safety outcomes are met.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: IMDA will continue to engage these app stores over the next few months on their implementation plans.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: IMDA will assess if the plans meet the requirements under the Code.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: It is also important to educate parents on their important role in keeping children safe online.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: To this end, the Government has put in place public education efforts to equip parents with the knowledge and skills to guide their children’s digital journey and safeguard them against risks online.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: Mr Yip, I am sorry, but we are out of time.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: I suspend the Sitting and will take the Chair at 3.30 pm.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: [Pursuant to Standing Order No 22(3), provided that Members had not asked for questions standing in their names to be postponed to a later Sitting day or withdrawn, written answers to questions not reached by the end of Question Time are reproduced in the Appendix.] Sitting accordingly suspended at 3.07 pm until 3.30 pm.
